lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out in my room with Ami.
lines.zh: 我决定晚上在自己房间里陪 Ami 待着。

lines.en: No matter what I suggest doing, she playfully refuses and beckons me into the bed to lie with her and hold her hand.
lines.zh: 不管我提议做什么，她都笑嘻嘻地拒绝，然后招手让我上床，躺在她旁边牵她的手。

lines.en: The next few hours pass by with her reciting memories that I wish I could have inherited when I arrived here.
lines.zh: 接下来几个小时，她一直在讲那些回忆——我多希望自己来到这儿的时候能继承这些记忆。

lines.en: Unfortunately, her relationship with me is much more than mine will ever be with her.
lines.zh: 可惜她和我的这段关系，比我与她之间的要厚重得多。

lines.en: And all of those memories that mean all of those things are more like anecdotes or poems.
lines.zh: 而所有那些承载着这些意义的记忆，更像是轶事或者诗。

lines.en: One thing that means the world to one person might make absolutely no sense to someone else.
lines.zh: 对一个人意义非凡的事，在另一个人看来可能完全说不通。

lines.en: I absorb the things she tells me, racking my brain and trying to connect any dots that someone else may have left behind.
lines.zh: 我把她讲的东西都吸收进来，绞尽脑汁，想把别人可能留下的线索串起来。

lines.en: But I come up with nothing.
I think Ami notices this at some point since she carefully tiptoes away from anything involving the past and makes her way into the present.
lines.zh: Ami 大概在某个时刻察觉到了，于是小心翼翼地绕开任何涉及过去的话题，慢慢把话头带到当下。

lines.en: We talk about[school]. We talk about the dorms.
We talk about everything up until our eyes close.
lines.zh: 一直聊到眼睛都闭上为止。

lines.en: Ami falls asleep before I do- the same way she always does when the two of us are in this position.
lines.zh: Ami 比我先睡着——每次我俩这样躺着，她都是这样。

lines.en: I stare at her face as she sleeps on my shoulder, her mouth slightly drooped open and exerting soft, sweet breaths.
lines.zh: 她靠在我肩上睡着，我盯着她的脸看，她嘴巴微微张开，呼出轻柔又甜的气息。

lines.en: She doesn't talk in her sleep, but she doesn't need to.
lines.zh: 她不说梦话，但她也不需要说。

lines.en: I can understand everything she's thinking and everything she's feeling just by keeping my eyes on her.
lines.zh: 只要一直看着她，我就能明白她在想什么、在感受什么。

lines.en: And so I do that until I, too, pass out...
lines.zh: 于是我就这么看着，直到自己也睡着……
